name: The Lobby
description: Level 0 is the first level of the Backrooms. It consists of a seemingly infinite network of interconnected rooms, all sharing the same yellow wallpaper, damp carpet, and buzzing fluorescent lights. The layout is non-Euclidean and constantly shifting, making navigation nearly impossible.
atmosphere: yellow wallpaper, buzzing fluorescent lights, damp carpet, mono-yellow hum, musty smell

name: Parking Zone
description: Level 1 resembles a massive, sprawling warehouse or parking garage. Concrete walls, exposed pipes, and flickering lights characterize this level. It is more dangerous than Level 0 but provides more resources.
atmosphere: concrete, exposed pipes, flickering lights, industrial hum, cold air

name: Pipe Dreams
description: Level 2 consists of long, dark maintenance hallways filled with pipes, electrical conduits, and machinery. The heat is oppressive and the air is thick with steam. This level is significantly more dangerous than the previous ones.
atmosphere: dark maintenance hallways, pipes, steam, oppressive heat, machinery noise

name: Electrical Station
description: Level 3 is an enormous electrical station with humming generators, exposed wiring, and periodic power surges. The level is extremely dangerous and should be avoided if possible.
atmosphere: electrical hum, exposed wiring, power surges, dark corridors, ozone smell

name: The Abandoned Office
description: Level 4 resembles an abandoned office building with empty cubicles, flickering lights, and scattered papers. It is relatively safe and a good place to rest.
atmosphere: abandoned office, empty cubicles, flickering lights, scattered papers, carpet floors

name: Terror Hotel
description: Level 5 is a vast, labyrinthine hotel with endless corridors, locked rooms, and a perpetual sense of dread. The architecture is inconsistent and reality feels unstable.
atmosphere: hotel corridors, locked rooms, velvet wallpaper, chandeliers, perpetual dusk

name: Lights Out
description: Level 6 is almost completely dark. The only illumination comes from rare emergency lights or bioluminescent organisms. This level is extremely dangerous due to the numerous hostile entities.
atmosphere: near-total darkness, emergency lights, bioluminescence, echoing footsteps

name: Thalassophobia
description: Level 7 consists of a vast ocean with a partially submerged structure. The water is dark and deep, and something massive moves beneath the surface.
atmosphere: dark ocean, submerged structures, waves, unknown depths, water sounds

name: Cave System
description: Level 8 is a massive cave system with bioluminescent fungi, underground rivers, and crystalline formations. It is one of the more habitable levels.
atmosphere: caves, bioluminescent fungi, underground rivers, crystals, damp air
